nodes.rationale: Filed upstream as vercel-labs/skills#2644 proposing per-path parseSkillMd memoization and a per-agent name->dir index to reduce full-home skills ls read amplification from ~60s to ~2.4s.

nodes.label: Downstream Serve List Cache & In-Flight Coalescing
nodes.source_location: ## What skills-ui did meanwhile (downstream, not a fix)
nodes.rationale: Preserves the wrap-don't-fork boundary by caching one ls --json result per scope per server, coalescing concurrent list requests onto one spawn, reusing cached before-set on remove, and invalidating only on mutations.
